correctness.rationale: The submitted q-colour transfer uses ordered adjacent columns (18 and 84 states for q=3,4) and tests exactly both cubic open-neighbourhood non-monochromatic conditions. Its length-n closed walks biject to labelled proper conflict-free prism colourings for all n>=3. An independently written integer dynamic-matrix computation reconstructed both charpolys via Newton sums over full dimensions (18+84=102 nonleading coefficients) and exact tr(T^n) for small n: for q=4, 264,384,3600,17472 at n=3..6; q=3 gives 12 exactly on multiples of 3. Formal log derivative of det(I-tT) supplies the all-n series. Shared-base cycles of lengths 3,4,5 give four-colour existence for every n>=3; 2-colours cannot satisfy cubic open-neighbourhood singleton condition. The x^3-4x^2-6x+4 root rho in (5,6) dominates other factors for asymptotic A4~rho^n; all proper four-colourings have dominant rate 7.
